_meta.name: APAC Kwikstage (steel, 120 cm)
_meta.note: Kwikstage facade scaffold from the APAC catalogue (no article codes: codes are descriptive). V-pressings every 495 mm, 1.98 m lift (4 x 0.495), 1.2 m transom with five 230 mm steel planks. 'verified' = false everywhere.
sources: 168261806-APAC-Scaffold-Formwork-Catalogue.pdf p.5-11 (Kwikstage: standards, transoms, banana ledgers p.8; diagonal braces, toe board bracket, wall ties p.9; end toe board bracket, base jack p.10; steel planks and LVL boards p.11)
168261806-APAC-Scaffold-Formwork-Catalogue.pdf p.36 (Tube & Fitting: drop-forged double coupler, used for the ties)
approvals: ISO 9001 (factory) only; no system approval named in the catalogue
changes: Ledger tube printed '48.8x3.2mm' (p.8, text layer and page image); assumed to be 48.3 (no 48.8 mm scaffold tube in EN 39 / BS 1139).

Lift 1980 mm and bays 1828 / 2438 mm taken from the diagonal table (p.9: 1828x1980, 2438x1980); the ledgers are sold as '1.8m' / '2.4m'. The 1.2 m ledger/transom centre 1268 mm comes from the 1268x1485 brace.
Width = 1.2 m transom (12.08 kg, p.8): 1268 + 48.3 = 1316 mm; 5 x 230 mm planks = 1150 mm (Kwikstage '5-board' platform).
Two deck grades: closed-end steel plank 230 mm (default) and LVL board 38 x 225 (both p.11).
Short bay 1.2 m (1268): ledger, plank and LVL board exist; its only brace is 1268x1485, so bracing in a 1.2 m bay is not catalogued (the engine only braces bays >= 1.5 m anyway).
Guard rails = ledgers (Kwikstage handrails are ledgers at 1 and 2 nodes above the deck).
Toeboard = LVL board 38x225 of bay length on edge + 1 Toe Board Bracket (0.8 kg) per bay; end toeboard = 1.2 m LVL board + End Toe Board Bracket (1.3 kg). Composite lines, masses from p.9-11.
Base jack 3.7 kg (p.10) has no published length or travel: length 0.6 m assumed (estimated), travel = 0.68 x length. The mass is from the source, so the jack line is not flagged as estimated.
No access deck with hatch (ladder access transoms only, p.9): no access decks are placed.
Tie = 0.6 m Wall Tie with 'S' hook (2.24 kg, p.9); couplers = APAC drop-forged double coupler 0.98 kg (p.36; the S-hook tie may need fewer); eyebolt 0.2 kg estimated (Plettac value).
End guard rail = 2 x 1.2 m ledger (2 x 5.25 kg).

system.load_classes_note: 'Heavy-duty access up to 4.0 kN/m2 platform loading' (p.6-7); bay and deck conditions not stated. 4.0 kN/m2 is above class 4 (3.0) but below class 5 (4.5), so class 4

rules_verified.note: Nothing in the APAC catalogue on ties, bracing frequency, wall gap or jack travel: all placeholders. The stair tower note (p.6-8: 4.4 m module, up to 50 m with ties) is not a facade rule. brace_est_mass_per_m = 2.95 from the APAC 1828x1980 brace (8.24 kg / 2.795 m), used only if a bay without a catalogued brace is braced.
